title: 第三章四天王临世 助力前行第四章黑风岭寨 群妖拦路
content_zh:
四人相互搀扶，踏出虎牢山道时，夕阳已斜坠西山，将天边染成一片昏黄。
一路疾行，不敢多做停留，直至远离那片阴森山林，寻到一处背风的山坳，才终于停下脚步。
山间晚风渐凉，吹得人衣衫作响，张忠东、陈学西、王学南身上的伤口，虽经宁洋北青木灵气滋养，不再剧痛，可依旧渗着血丝，周身疲惫感席卷而来，三人靠在山石上，闭目调息，缓着体力。
宁洋北则站在一旁，眼神凝重，回想着白日里那场惊心动魄的苦战，心中久久无法平静。
他低头看向自己的双手，掌心依旧残留着一丝温润的青光，白日里那股突然涌现的力量，依旧清晰可感。他始终想不明白，那股力量从何而来，为何会在绝境之时，护着他们四人，更想不通，他们四人身上，究竟藏着怎样的秘密。
王学南缓缓睁开眼，看着陷入沉思的宁洋北，又看了看身旁养伤的张忠东和陈学西，沉声开口：“白日里那股力量，绝非凡人所有，我虽记不起过往，却能感知到，这力量本就属于我们，是刻在我们神魂深处的本源之力。”
陈学西睁开眼，眼神冰冷中带着几分思索，点头附和：“方才应战之时，脑海中总有模糊碎片闪过，仿佛与生俱来，便懂这般杀伐御敌之法。”
张忠东揉了揉手臂上的伤口，咧嘴一笑，满是不在意：“管它力量从何而来，只要能护着同伴，能斩除妖邪，能一路西行救百姓，便是好力量！往后再有妖邪作祟，我们依旧能并肩应战！”
宁洋北抬眼，看向三位同伴，眼中满是坚定：“忠东说得没错，无论我们身世如何，力量何来，我们西行救世的初心，始终不变。只是今日这群豺狼妖，不过是山间小妖，便让我等身陷险境，前路西行，必定还有更凶险的劫难，我们需得尽快提升自身之力，方能应对往后的危机。”
就在四人交谈之际，原本平静的天际，突然霞光万丈，祥云涌动，阵阵仙乐缥缈传来，威严浩荡的仙气，自九天之上倾泻而下，笼罩整片山坳。
四人皆是一惊，猛地站起身，抬头望向天际，眼中满是震惊。
只见云端之中，四道伟岸身影，脚踏祥云，身披仙甲，手持法器，周身仙气缭绕，威严盖世，缓缓自天际降临，落在四人面前。
为首一人，身着青色仙甲，手持青云剑，面容威严，正是东方持国天王，周身萦绕着祥和仙气，主护持众生，镇守东方天界；
左侧一人，身披白色仙甲，手持琵琶，神态肃穆，乃是南方增长天王，一身锐气，主增长善根，护佑天地生灵；
右侧一人，身着红色仙甲，手握宝剑，气势凌厉，为西方广目天王，目光锐利，能观三界诸事，震慑妖邪；
最后一人，身披绿色仙甲，手持宝伞，沉稳大气，便是北方多闻天王，广闻佛法，护持人间财富与安宁。
竟是天庭四大天王，奉玉帝法旨，下界而来！
四人皆是凡身，虽无天界记忆，可面对四大天王周身散发的浩荡仙威，依旧心生敬畏，不由自主地躬身行礼，不敢直视。
“晚辈等人，见过四位仙长。”宁洋北率先收敛心神，恭敬开口，其余三人也纷纷跟着行礼。
四大天王相视一眼，持国天王上前一步，声音威严浩荡，响彻山坳：“宁洋北、张忠东、王学南、陈学西，我等四人，奉玉帝法旨，特地下界，相助你等西行。”

四人闻言，皆是满脸震惊，心中掀起惊涛骇浪。
他们从未想过，自己一行凡夫俗子，竟能惊动天界仙人，更遑论是四大天王亲自下界相助。
“仙长，您……您怎会知晓我等姓名？”宁洋北压下心中震惊，恭敬问道，满心疑惑。
“你等四人，本非凡人，乃是天界镇守四方的青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武四方神君，因人间瘟疫肆虐，苍生涂炭，奉玉帝法旨，褪去仙骨，封印仙法与记忆，下凡历劫，西行求取创世玉盘，救世安民。”广目天王声音平静，却字字清晰，传入四人耳中。
这番话，如同惊雷，在四人心底轰然炸开！
他们终于明白，自己为何会有莫名的救世执念，为何绝境之中会涌现神秘力量，为何彼此之间有着与生俱来的默契。
原来，他们本是天界四方神君，此番下凡，乃是肩负天命，历劫救世！
张忠东、陈学西、王学南三人，皆是满脸错愕，怔怔地站在原地，脑海中那些模糊的记忆碎片，与天王所言一一对应，渐渐清晰起来。
“我等……竟是天界神君？”宁洋北喃喃自语，心中震撼不已，随即躬身行礼，“晚辈愚钝，竟不知自身天命，有劳四位天王下界相助。”
“你等仙法记忆被封，凡身历劫，需历经尘世磨难，方能逐步觉醒，不可强行解封，”增长天王轻抚手中琵琶，沉声说道，“虎牢山道豺狼妖，不过是西行第一难，前路妖邪更甚，劫难更险，更有盘踞西天的上古妖王，窥伺创世玉盘，妄图祸乱三界，凭你等如今苏醒的微末神力，根本难以应对。”
content_en:
The four of them supported each other and stepped out of the Hulao Mountain Road. The setting sun had already dipped down onto the Western Mountain, turning the horizon into a hazy yellow.
They drove quickly without daring to stop for too long, until they were far away from the gloomy forest and found a mountain col with leeward wind, and then they finally stopped.
The evening wind in the mountains was getting colder, making people's clothes rustle. Although the wounds on Zhang Zhongdong, Chen Xuexi, and Wang Xuenan were no longer painful after being nourished by the spiritual energy of Ningyang Beiqingmu, they were still oozing with blood. A sense of exhaustion swept through their bodies. The three of them leaned on the rocks, closed their eyes and adjusted their breath to slow down their physical strength.
Ning Yangbei stood aside, his eyes solemn, recalling the thrilling battle during the day, and his heart could not calm down for a long time.
He lowered his head and looked at his hands. There was still a touch of warm green light in his palms, and the sudden surge of power during the day was still clearly palpable. He still couldn't figure out where that power came from, why it protected the four of them in a desperate situation, and he couldn't figure out what kind of secrets the four of them had hidden in them.
Wang Xuenan slowly opened his eyes, looked at Ning Yangbei who was deep in thought, and then at Zhang Zhongdong and Chen Xuexi who were recovering from injuries beside him, and said in a deep voice: "The power during the day is extraordinary. Although I can't remember the past, I can feel that this power belongs to us. It is the original power engraved deep in our souls."
Chen Xuexi opened his eyes, his eyes were cold and thoughtful, and he nodded in agreement: "When I just accepted the battle, there were always vague fragments flashing through my mind, as if I was born with this method of killing and defending the enemy."
Zhang Zhongdong rubbed the wound on his arm, grinned, and said nonchalantly: "No matter where the power comes from, as long as it can protect its companions, kill evil spirits, and travel westward to save the people, it is a good power! If there are evil evils in the future, we can still fight side by side!"
Ning Yangbei raised his eyes and looked at his three companions, his eyes full of determination: "Zhongdong is right. No matter what our life experience is or where our strength comes from, our original intention of going west to save the world will always remain unchanged. It's just that this group of jackal monsters today are just little mountain monsters, and they have put us in danger. Going westward, there must be more dangerous disasters. We need to improve our strength as soon as possible to be able to deal with future crises."
Just as the four people were talking, the originally calm sky was suddenly illuminated by rays of light, auspicious clouds surged, bursts of fairy music could be heard, and the majestic fairy energy poured down from the nine heavens, covering the entire mountain col.
All four of them were startled. They stood up suddenly and looked up at the sky, their eyes full of shock.
I saw four majestic figures in the clouds, with their feet on the auspicious clouds, wearing fairy armor, holding magic weapons, surrounded by fairy aura, majestic and majestic, slowly descending from the sky and landing in front of the four people.
The leader is wearing a green fairy armor, holding a Qingyun Sword, and has a majestic face. He is the Heavenly King of the Eastern Kingdom. He is surrounded by a peaceful fairy spirit, protects all living beings, and guards the Eastern Heaven;
The person on the left is wearing white fairy armor, holding a pipa, and has a solemn expression. He is the King of Growth in the South. He is full of energy and is responsible for growing good roots and protecting all living beings in the world;
The person on the right is wearing red fairy armor, holding a sword in his hand, and has a fierce momentum. He is the Western King of Wide Eyes. His eyes are sharp and he can observe everything in the three realms and deter evil spirits;
The last person, wearing green fairy armor and holding a treasure umbrella, is calm and majestic. He is the king of the north who has heard the Buddha's teachings widely and protects the wealth and peace of the world.
It turns out that they are the four heavenly kings of heaven, who came from the lower world in accordance with the Jade Emperor's decree!
The four of them are all mortals. Although they have no memory of the heavenly realm, they are still in awe when faced with the mighty immortal power emanating from the four heavenly kings. They bow involuntarily and salute without daring to look directly at them.
"Juniors and others have met four immortal elders." Ning Yangbei took the lead to calm down and spoke respectfully, and the other three people also followed suit.
The four heavenly kings looked at each other, and King Chiguo took a step forward. His voice was majestic and powerful, resounding throughout the mountain: "Ningyangbei, Zhang Zhongdong, Wang Xuenan, Chen Xuexi, we and four others, in accordance with the Jade Emperor's decree, specially went to the lower realm to help you while you are traveling westward. "
When the four people heard this, their faces were full of shock, and their hearts were filled with turmoil.
They never thought that they, a group of ordinary people, could alarm the immortals in the heaven, let alone the four heavenly kings personally coming down to help.
"Immortal, you...how do you know our names? "Ning Yangbei suppressed the shock in his heart and asked respectfully, full of doubts.
"You and the other four are not ordinary people. They are the four divine kings of Qinglong, White Tiger, Suzaku, and Xuanwu who guard the four directions in the heaven. Due to the raging plague in the world and the devastation of the people, in accordance with the Jade Emperor's decree, they shed their immortal bones, sealed the immortal magic and memories, and descended to earth to endure tribulations. They traveled west to seek for the Jade Plate of Creation, so as to save the world and bring peace to the people. "King Guangmu's voice was calm, but every word was clear, and it reached the ears of four people.
These words were like thunder, exploding in the hearts of the four of them!
They finally understood why they had an inexplicable obsession with saving the world, why mysterious powers emerged in desperate situations, and why they had an innate understanding of each other.
It turns out that they were originally the divine kings of the four directions in the heaven. They came down to earth this time to shoulder the destiny and save the world from calamity!
Zhang Zhongdong, Chen Xuexi, and Wang Xuenan all stood there with astonishment on their faces. The vague memory fragments in their minds corresponded one by one to what the King of Heaven said, and gradually became clear.
"Wait... we are actually the God Lord of Heaven? Ning Yangbei murmured to himself, shocked in his heart, and then bowed and saluted, "This junior is so stupid that he doesn't know his own destiny, so he needs help from the four heavenly kings. "
"When your memory of immortal magic is sealed, you will have to go through calamities and tribulations in the world before you can gradually awaken. You cannot forcefully unblock it," the King of Growth gently stroked the pipa in his hand and said in a deep voice, "The jackal monster on Hulao Mountain Road, but This is the first difficulty of the journey to the west. There are more evil spirits and more dangerous catastrophes on the road ahead. There is also an ancient demon king who occupies the western sky, spying on the Jade Plate of Creation and trying to bring disaster to the three realms. It is simply difficult for you to deal with it with your little divine power that has awakened now. "
